goalSource.document: YNX Chain — Founder-Grade Coordinated Final Goal Prompts
goalSource.instructionDocument: YNX 36 产品全量恢复与极致交付——通用长期执行指令

entries.requirement: Preserve recovered work and enforce truthful, isolated, secure Founder-grade delivery.
subrequirements: Recover rather than restart; scan worktree, branches, tags, reflog, actions, releases, artifacts, dirty changes, processes, servers and public endpoints.
Never reset --hard, clean, force-push, discard dirty changes, delete newer modules or replace the repository with a blank project.
Modify only 01-chain-core and coordinate cross-product changes through contract, schema, patch, handoff and test vectors.
Maintain nine independent release booleans and set them true only with direct evidence.
Reject TODO, FIXME, placeholders, fake balances, users, transactions, prices, revenue, APY, liquidity, providers, health, hard-coded success, no-op UI and production mocks.
Separate YNX authoritative state, third-party data, estimates, AI inference, cache and user input; carry source, asOf, version, confidence or coverage and failure state where applicable.

Use accepted Wallet/Auth, product registration, device challenge, approval, product session, introspection, expiry, revocation and App Gateway; fail closed for replay, tamper, wrong product, bundle or device, scope widening, expiry and revoke.

Keep user assets in user Wallet, Exchange subaccount, DEX Strategy Vault, approved custodian or protocol contract; prohibit service private keys, arbitrary withdrawal, owner change and mandate widening.
Prefer official standards, APIs, SDKs and Testnets; record terms, jurisdiction, auth, limits, retention, rights, version, health and fallback; fail honestly when unavailable.
AI may draft, explain, translate, summarize, research, preview, simulate and propose, but may not sign, pay, trade, withdraw, publish, delete, change permissions or risk, govern or upgrade consensus.
Use YNX Klein Blue, white and neutral black or gray while preserving independent products and truthful empty, loading, success, failure, offline, permission, expired and recovery states.
Support 12 languages, real Arabic RTL, keyboard, screen reader, focus, contrast, dynamic type, reduced motion, light and dark modes and 390px without overflow.
Deliver all applicable server, CLI, SDK, Docker and client artifacts and distinguish test, simulator, unsigned, production-signed and store states.
Measure p50, p95, p99, throughput, concurrency, queues, storage growth, provider latency and limits, cold start, error rate, RTO, RPO, availability and unit economics.
Version schemas, state, APIs, artifacts and config; complete migration, compatibility, rollback migration, backup, restore, export, delete, retention and shutdown exit paths.
Provide logs, metrics, traces, request, error and audit IDs, health, version, alerts, SLO dashboards, runbooks, status, support, disputes and recovery without leaking secrets or internal paths.
Maintain threat model, security boundaries, SBOM, notices, dependency and lockfile review, secret, SAST, DAST, container and artifact scans, provenance and reproducible-build evidence.

Keep fees, burn, treasury and risk transparent; prohibit hidden spread, unrealized-profit fees, reset fees, wash trading, fake volume, guaranteed returns, secret buybacks and hidden mint or burn; burn is not revenue.
Produce public metadata, canonical route, FAQ, screenshots, risk and status, artifact and support URLs and structured-data suggestions without internal names, paths or stale network facts.
Maintain completion, evidence, UI, migration, observability, release and operations records bound to exact source commits.
Define activation, retention, task completion, crash-free, support load, abuse, provider cost, margin, Testnet usage, conversion and kill or scale decisions without dark patterns.
Request only minimal true external inputs after autonomous engineering is exhausted and never request secrets in chat.

Run final test, build, smoke, security, migration, restore and public evidence; update handoff, commit, push, verify local equals remote and keep the goal Active or Blocked while evidence is incomplete.
blockedBy: hosted signed artifact and independent public evidence
entries.nextAction: Continue closing the highest-priority autonomous TESTNET, integration, security and release gaps without changing public booleans prematurely.

entries.requirement: Advance RECOVER → PROTECT → FREEZE → INTEGRATE → TESTNET → PUBLIC → EXPAND and preserve one authoritative owner per fact.
subrequirements: Verify branch, status, local and remote SHA, ahead or behind, dirty changes, processes and CI before each round.
Push verified commits before new work or create a verifiable recovery bundle after bounded failure.
Maintain release/integration/chain-core-contract.json, docs/integration/INTEGRATION_HANDOFF.md, CROSS_PRODUCT_TEST_VECTORS.json and DEPENDENCY_ACCEPTANCE.md.

Record owner, source commit, schema, API, auth scope, wallet tuple, signed intent, canonical events, error codes, health and version, migration, vectors, dependencies, external inputs and release states.
Do not maintain conflicting long-term scopes, digests, events, errors, asset statuses, fees or release facts; submit conflicts and migration to 29-integration.
Prioritize real Wallet, Data Fabric, Oracle, Explorer, Monitor, Trust and execution-place end-to-end flows over feature count.
After two real dependency failures, preserve evidence, identify owner and recovery conditions, stay fail closed and continue adapters, migration, negative tests, backup, restore and evidence work.
Finish each slice with tests, review, evidence and release updates, commit, push, SHA verification and a precise next action.

entries.requirement: Freeze and verify the unique YNX Testnet identity.
subrequirements: Cosmos Chain ID is ynx_6423-1.
EVM Chain ID is 6423 or 0x1917.
Native asset is YNXT.
Native user addresses default to ynx1 and 0x is compatibility only.
6423 remains Testnet permanently and future Mainnet uses a new unique Chain ID.
Maintain verifiable metadata, add-chain parameters, RPC, Explorer, Faucet and logo evidence; Founder owns upstream ChainList submission.
entries.nextAction: Verify public RPC, Explorer, Faucet and wallet add-chain metadata against current source.

entries.requirement: Prove the real four-validator CometBFT safety, finality and recovery baseline.
subrequirements: Same genesis, validator set, binary and release manifest.
Fixed-height Block Hash and AppHash agreement with at least 3 of 4 precommits.
Continue producing blocks after one validator stops and catch up after recovery.
Double-sign protection and Byzantine evidence.
Snapshot, State Sync, backup, restore and rollback.
Broadcast once and query identical committed state from all nodes.
Signed YNXT transfer with nonce, fee, receipt, logs, account history and replay rejection.
entries.nextAction: Repeat the full failure, recovery and transaction proof on remote current-source validators and publish independent evidence.

entries.requirement: Keep CometBFT as the baseline until StreamBFT wins the full formal, differential and adversarial bake-off.
subrequirements: Multi-worker DAG transaction dissemination and data-availability or ordering separation.
Pipelined chained HotStuff or Jolteon-style candidate, adaptive pacemaker, deterministic rotation and asynchronous fallback.
Aggregate or threshold QC candidate with Ed25519 fallback and parallel signature verification.
Deterministic proposal construction, Block-STM-style parallel execution, sequential fallback and state-root determinism.
Semantic transaction lanes, per-lane congestion control and local fee markets.
Shadow mode, canary, feature flag and one-command rollback.
TLA+ or Apalache-equivalent model and CometBFT differential replay.
4, 7, 13 and 21 validators; multi-region WAN; Byzantine leader; equivocation; partition; packet loss; clock drift; DDoS; crash; state sync and long soak.
Retain CometBFT whenever the candidate cannot prove overall superiority.
entries.nextAction: Execute and archive the remaining model-check, differential replay, WAN, Byzantine and long-soak matrix.

entries.requirement: Provide deterministic execution, resource metering and isolated fee markets.
subrequirements: Nine lanes: Consensus or Governance; Oracle or Bridge or Risk; Liquidation; Cancel or Mass Cancel; Trading Orders; Pay or Stable Settlement; General EVM; Service Settlement; Bulk Data Commitment.
Explicit access or conflict hints, optimistic parallel execution, deterministic conflict commit and sequential fallback.
Multi-dimensional resource metering, state-growth pricing and end-of-block aggregation.
EIP-1559-style base-fee candidate and local markets for EVM, Trading, Pay, AI, Cloud and Bulk commitments.
Congestion in one business cannot block Wallet Recovery, Trust Appeal or unrelated lanes.
entries.nextAction: Complete saturation, priority-inversion, deterministic state-root and governance-parameter tests.

entries.requirement: Deliver noncustodial chain-level Smart Account, StrategyMandate and Vault primitives.
subrequirements: Smart Account, UserOperation, Bundler, Paymaster, Session Key, Passkey, Guardian Recovery, Batch Call, Sponsored Gas and stablecoin gas.

StrategyMandate binds owner, engine identity, strategy hash and version, venue, assets, markets, methods, capital, position, leverage, slippage, daily loss, drawdown, expiry, nonce domain, revoke and kill switch.
Exchange API wallet is no-withdraw and subaccount-only.
DEX Strategy Vault permits owner-only withdrawal and emergency exit.
Emit strategy, vault, fee, risk and audit events.
Management and high-water-mark performance-fee invariants; performance fee only on realized net profit after all costs.
Quant, AI and product services cannot withdraw, change owner, widen permissions or bypass revoke.
blockedBy: real DEX router and pool integration
entries.nextAction: Close passkey, guardian and stablecoin-gas gaps and run real Exchange and DEX end-to-end flows.

entries.requirement: Deploy and verify the complete Chain Core service surface with truthful operations.
subrequirements: RPC, EVM RPC, REST and gRPC.
Faucet, Indexer and Explorer backend.
App Gateway and Wallet/Auth Gateway.
Trading API and WebSocket, Oracle API and Economics or Solvency API.
Pay, Trust, Resource and AI gateways and Quant Mandate APIs.
Every service returns real health, version, commit, release, dependency status, startedAt and metrics and has systemd or container, least privilege, backup and rollback.
blockedBy: central Wallet, Oracle and Data Fabric acceptance
entries.nextAction: Finish gRPC and central service acceptance, then run a current-source remote service audit.

entries.requirement: Maintain committed EVM compatibility and durable, tamper-rejecting Indexer persistence.
subrequirements: EVM network, block, balance, nonce, code, call, estimate, signed broadcast, transaction, receipt and log methods.
Block transaction count by number or hash and transaction lookup by block number or hash plus canonical index.

Validate CometBFT AppHash, DataHash and raw-transaction evidence; return null for pending, missing and out-of-range lookups, -32602 for invalid parameters and -32603 for upstream or evidence failures.

Accept bounded chain-6423 EIP-155 legacy type-0 value transfers with recovered sender, zero-based nonce, exact 21000 gas, dual Ethereum or Comet transaction identity and audited committed receipt evidence.
Accept bounded EIP-2930 type-0x01 value transfers only with an empty access list, y-parity sender recovery, exact 21000 gas, dual identity and truthful type-0x1 transaction and receipt mapping.

Accept bounded EIP-1559 type-0x02 transfers only with chain ID 6423, zero compatibility base fee, 0 < maxPriorityFeePerGas <= maxFeePerGas, maximum-fee affordability, effective-fee debit, empty access list, exact 21000 gas and truthful type-0x2 mapping.

Expose eth_gasPrice and eth_maxPriorityFeePerGas as the protocol minimum 0x1 only; expose eth_feeHistory only from retained committed blocks, block_results gas and positive exact-height consensus max_gas, with zero base fees, no reward estimates, -32004 for unavailable truthful ratios and -32603 for inconsistent evidence.

Return a successful bounded Ethereum broadcast only after raw block membership, AppHash, DataHash, Comet gas, dual transaction identity and audited receipt evidence agree; classify duplicates as -32003 and evidence mismatches as -32603.
Provide a mode-0600 multi-envelope signer CLI and configurable positive-only local consensus fixture without exposing private key material or claiming production signing.

Reject wrong-chain, replayed, malformed, unsupported typed, non-empty-access-list, contract-creation, calldata and audit-tampered envelopes or evidence without claiming a dynamic base-fee market or general Ethereum execution.
Indexer validates the full incoming batch before journaling and requires exact height, parent and transaction invariants.
Checkpoint and WAL must be private 0600 regular files; reject unknown fields, trailing JSON, symlinks, tampering and conflicting duplicates.
WAL and checkpoint writes are fsync-bound; checkpoint uses atomic rename and directory fsync; checkpoint or WAL overlap crash recovery remains valid.
Returned databases, blocks, transactions, lot flows, logs and topics are deep-cloned so callers cannot mutate internal state.

Cross-region public smoke passes.
